purpose: Define provenance for every machine-significant DWH transformation, including operation identity, input refs, output refs, rule/version and execution evidence.

topics.name: DWH Transformation Provenance
topics.purpose: Define provenance for every machine-significant DWH transformation, including operation identity, input refs, output refs, rule/version and execution evidence.

semantics.operation_rule: Transformation semantics resolve to an exact canonical operation/rule.
semantics.input_rule: All machine-significant contributing inputs are explicitly referenced.
semantics.output_rule: Produced outputs reference the transformation provenance.
semantics.version_rule: Rule/schema/code version affecting semantics is explicit.
semantics.runtime_rule: Runtime execution identity is separate from canonical transformation definition identity.
semantics.determinism_rule: Where declared deterministic, same accepted inputs/rule version yield semantically equivalent outputs.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed/partial transformations do not masquerade as complete derived outputs.

invariants.rule: Derived DWH data retains explicit source lineage, transformation provenance and applicable classification/taint state; transformations never silently erase origin or governance metadata.

hard_gates.condition: transformation has no exact rule/operation identity
runtime run identity used as transformation definition identity
partial failure recorded as successful complete output

prose.summary: Define provenance for every machine-significant DWH transformation, including operation identity, input refs, output refs, rule/version and execution evidence.
